title: Turkey Mercedes
description: Thanksgiving turkey has been given a Cuban twist! We celebrate this American holiday by preparing a turkey marinated with the flavors of Cuba. The recipe is foolproof and the turkey is the best you'll ever taste!
ingredients: 0.5 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed

steps.text: Crush the peeled garlic cloves, and place into a large bowl. Season with pepper, cumin, oregano, and salt. Pour in lemon juice, wine, and orange juice concentrate; whisk together until well mixed.

Using a sharp paring knife, pierce the turkey breast, thighs, and legs; creating holes for the marinade to penetrate. Pour the marinade over turkey, and into the holes. Finally, stuff garlic pieces into the holes. Cover the turkey well, and refrigerate overnight to marinate.
Preheat oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C).

Roast turkey in the preheated oven until the internal temperature of the thickest part of the thigh measures 180 degrees F (80 degrees C), about 5 hours. Baste the turkey every 30 to 45 minutes. Once the breast has browned, cover loosely with aluminum foil to prevent it from becoming burnt.

video.description: Celebrate your Thanksgiving holiday this year with the great flavors of Cuba. Begin by crushing garlic cloves with pepper, cumin, oregano and salt, then pour in lemon juice, white wine and orange juice concentrate. After piercing the breast, thighs and legs of your roast turkey, pour on the marinade, then stuff pieces of garlic into the holes and chill overnight to marinate. Roast the turkey for 5 hours, taking care to marinate every half hour or so . . . the result will be incredibly fragrant and flavorful and wonderfully melt-in-your-mouth tender. Garnish with citrus and fresh herbs for a complete centerpiece!
